description:
A canister drops into the tray, lighter than a bill. Inside is a receipt, BACK RENT, No. 9 Sprocket Row, 1,400 Crowns, PAID, in Pip's best capitals, and a toffee in a twist of newspaper.

"All of it. I read the figure to the clerk twice, for the pleasure. Hester gave me a toffee every Friday, and the rent next week. You have paid the rent, so the toffee is yours. No more Fridays. I may come round anyway, for the"

The note stops there. There is a thumbprint in the sugar.

options.label: Eat the toffee, and put the receipt on the spike.

success.text: It takes some time to eat, and has a little of Pip's pocket in it. The bill comes off the spike and the receipt goes on, and the spike looks better for it. It is the first thing in No. 9 that anyone has finished.
